experiment_proposal.terminal_assessment: Report remaining debt, guarantees, maintenance, restoration and treaty obligations beyond 1932; use an explicitly modelled tail or an unresolved-liability bound.
experiment_proposal.decision_clock: Annual budget and strategic decisions; monthly finance and response cycles; finer logistics/crisis steps when the supported module requires them.
experiment_proposal.control_scope: Pacifica executive agenda under an explicit person/institution controller binding and dated authority. Separate domestic and foreign choices remain independent; no silent replacement of enabled personal intentions by the optimizer.
experiment_proposal.initial_state: Versioned reconstruction at the fork, with balance sheets, assets, obligations, laws, rights, beliefs and inherited capability; a 1932 snapshot cannot initialize 1904.
experiment_proposal.baseline_role: Financial regression and comparator policy reconstructed from the master; authored future outcomes only in labelled fixture replay.
experiment_proposal.control_role: Shared-change control in the existing manifest: first divergence from baseline in 1904. Its exact shared inputs must be retrieved from the frozen bundle before policy reconstruction; it is not a no-action policy.
experiment_proposal.comparison: Identical objective contracts, boundaries, starting conditions and exogenous-world design for a common-start policy contest. Separately label scenario-package comparisons with different assumptions.
experiment_proposal.scope_note: EXP-PILOT-01 remains the broader proposed campaign. R0 selects a shorter bounded dilemma and only its supported metrics; the eight families and full roster are not R0 scope.

first_slice.question: 1927–1928 Japan rescue and Concord dilemma with a scoped commitment/disclosure conflict and independently chosen responses.
first_slice.breach_scope: One bounded exceptional-conduct family with explicit additive permission sets, variant-specific support and independent actual legality. Test ordinary lawful conduct in every profile and lawful Pacifica facing independently chosen supported misconduct.
first_slice.author_gate: Before tuning, record the actual tasks and numeric time/repair budgets. Run prepared/open/held-out work and the scoped manual comparator; record prior exposure and learning/order limitations. The author inspects assumptions, retains at least one previously unconsidered usable plot possibility, then branches from that retained idea into a subsequent supported dilemma. Save and replay the chain with unchanged identity. Pass only with the retained-and-developed idea, inspectable assumptions, supported branch/replay, completed required tasks and explicit author acceptance under the predeclared time/repair limits. A failed budget or required case needs repair and reassessment or an explicit prospective scope/protocol revision; never retroactively widen limits to pass.
first_slice.preimplementation_gate: Activate an independently audited 1927–1928 rescue/Concord package and prove the bounded semantic prototype before optimized interfaces: replayable unknown state, typed evidence assessments, protected ambiguity, dated information, independent choice, additive conduct and resource settlement. Include source-omission injection, relational failure cases and isolated-action/low-effect contrasts. Predeclare actual author tasks and numeric time/repair budgets; measure audited data effort, decision waiting and peak memory/disk/latency.

objectives.name: Core prosperity
objectives.beneficiary: Usual residents of Pacifica's core economic perimeter, including qualifying guest workers under a declared residency rule.
objectives.geography: North American/core perimeter used by the financial model; Hawaii, Philippines and partners reported separately unless a new explicit perimeter is selected.
objectives.definition: For each path, sum annual real household consumption per usual resident times the fraction of year. Consumption is measured after taxes, domestic and foreign income flows, and remittances using a consistent household-account bridge.
objectives.unit: 1913-price currency per usual resident, accumulated over the decision horizon.
objectives.time_aggregation: Sum of annual per-person consumption; report 1932 level and worst-year change separately.
objectives.across_futures: Primary statistic: lower 10th percentile of the path total. Also show median, upper tail and convergence uncertainty. Quantile level is a draft risk preference.
objectives.observation_and_truth: Score realized model quantities; decisions use only contemporary estimates. Keep true and published accounts distinct.
objectives.terminal_failure: Continue civilian welfare accounting after military or fiscal failure using the defined successor/continuation state; unresolved continuation produces an explicit outcome interval, not a fabricated consumption series.
objectives.coverage_gate: Blocked until population, deflators, household consumption and distribution boundaries exist. Real GDP/person may be a separately named proxy; nominal GDP cannot silently substitute.

objectives.name: Security and freedom of action
objectives.beneficiary: Pacifica and the explicitly named communities covered by its security commitments.
objectives.geography: A fixed campaign list of sovereign areas, essential routes and defensive commitments.
objectives.definition: Count calendar days when at least one required security condition is materially unmet: a named area under hostile coercive control, an essential route unusable beyond its allowed interruption, or an agreed defensive obligation unsatisfied. Define each condition and tolerance before search.
objectives.unit: Security-failure days; no double-counting simultaneous failures in the headline total.
objectives.time_aggregation: Cumulative failure days, with separate failure cause, duration, recovery and terminal-loss indicators.
objectives.across_futures: Primary statistic: upper 90th percentile of failure days. Report each condition's incidence and joint attainment with the other objectives.
objectives.observation_and_truth: Score actual territorial/access/capability states; actors act on incomplete reports. A signed treaty does not itself prove usable access or readiness.
objectives.terminal_failure: Irrecoverable loss of a required sovereign condition counts as failed for the remaining horizon. Do not stop counting when the government falls.
objectives.coverage_gate: Blocked until threats, rights, force readiness, logistics and a declared mission test are represented. No universal national-power index.

objectives.name: Treasury resilience
objectives.beneficiary: Pacifica's public service users and public creditors within the declared fiscal perimeter.
objectives.geography: Core Treasury, with separate crown, local, common-institution and Reserve Bank accounts.
objectives.definition: At each monthly opening, compute 12 × unrestricted Treasury cash / unavoidable cash outlays due during the next twelve months under existing law and contracts. Commitments cannot be deleted from the denominator; avoid counting the same available cash twice.
objectives.unit: Months of unavoidable public cash outlays covered.
objectives.time_aggregation: Minimum monthly coverage over the path; separately report arrears, gross debt, debt service, tax capacity and public net worth.
objectives.across_futures: Primary statistic: lower 10th percentile of path-minimum coverage. Show default and unfunded-essential-outlay incidence alongside it.
objectives.observation_and_truth: Use reconciled monthly cash and obligation ledgers; forecast-denominator error is part of uncertainty. Zero required outlays needs an explicit no-obligation result rather than division by zero.
objectives.terminal_failure: Coverage is zero from a sovereign payment failure until a modelled resolution restores it; arrears and losses remain in the ledger. A zero is an outcome, not a missing value.
objectives.coverage_gate: Requires native cash, debt, maturity, guarantee and essential-service schedules. Reserve Bank gold and private subscriptions are not unrestricted Treasury cash.

objectives.name: Human cost
objectives.beneficiary: All materially affected populations, including foreign civilians, military personnel, guest workers and displaced communities.
objectives.geography: All theatres and territories materially affected by the tested policies, with documented exclusions.
objectives.definition: Count military and civilian deaths from modelled conflict and disruption once per person/event. Show civilian, military and partner breakdowns, displacement and person-years of deprivation separately.
objectives.unit: Deaths; companion measures in displaced persons and person-years of disruption.
objectives.time_aggregation: Cumulative through 1932 plus explicitly estimated delayed mortality, with timing and attribution rules.
objectives.across_futures: Primary statistic: upper 90th percentile of cumulative deaths. Also show mean and catastrophic-loss incidence.
objectives.observation_and_truth: Underlying casualty ledger scores outcomes; contemporaneous reported losses may be delayed or false. Missing foreign deaths cannot become zero.
objectives.terminal_failure: Continue the harm ledger after defeat, default or political collapse; label intervals when a continuation model is incomplete.
objectives.coverage_gate: Blocked until a usable casualty/disruption model and population coverage exist. Natural mortality and policy-related deaths require distinct categories to avoid double-counting.

objectives.name: Durable voluntary cooperation
objectives.beneficiary: Pacifica and a named partner, evaluated as separate parties.
objectives.geography: One selected relationship or access agreement per objective component.
objectives.definition: Measure the fraction of the horizon for which the named functional cooperation has valid consent and both sides fulfil its material obligations. Fix the function in advance so a different lawful treaty can provide it.
objectives.unit: Fraction of time, with consent, performance and autonomy reported separately.
objectives.time_aggregation: Time in qualifying cooperation, interruption duration and renewal outcome.
objectives.across_futures: Lower 10th percentile for each selected relationship. Keep partner components separate rather than adding treaty counts.
objectives.observation_and_truth: Ratification, access use, payment and independent partner decisions provide evidence. Alignment is not inferred from receiving a loan.
objectives.terminal_failure: Cooperation lapses when consent or performance fails; coerced continuation does not count as voluntary success.
objectives.coverage_gate: Requires independent actor response, refusal/exit options, treaty obligations and an anchored consent definition.

objectives.name: Institutional durability
objectives.beneficiary: Residents and the institutions holding reserved constitutional powers.
objectives.geography: Realm, Hawaiian and Philippine institutions and, if formed, the Concord.
objectives.definition: Count days of material unauthorized government action or interruption of the agreed constitutional order. Define the materiality tests and institutions before search; report each type of breach.
objectives.unit: Institutional-breach days and discrete rupture events.
objectives.time_aggregation: Cumulative breach days, reversals, legal cure and lasting damage. A later indemnity does not erase earlier breach days.
objectives.across_futures: Upper 90th percentile of breach days; separate coup, failed-ratification and succession-risk incidence.
objectives.observation_and_truth: Authority, enacted law and observable institutional actions govern the legal test. Acceptance or legitimacy states use anchored qualitative descriptions when numeric evidence is weak.
objectives.terminal_failure: Record institutional collapse through the remaining horizon, with later restoration explicitly simulated.
objectives.coverage_gate: Requires time-dependent constitutional powers and domestic actor behavior. Do not present an invented 0–100 legitimacy score.

objectives.name: Watershed and ecological resilience
objectives.beneficiary: Affected Hawaiian communities, future land users and ecological systems within the chosen boundary.
objectives.geography: Named watersheds and reef systems; expand only with additional coverage.
objectives.definition: For one declared watershed, integrate max(0, adopted minimum stream flow − actual flow) over time. Keep reef condition, restoration liabilities, smoke exposure, fishery output and public access as separate diagnostics.
objectives.unit: Cubic metres of water-flow deficit; alternative ecological objectives require their own contracts.
objectives.time_aggregation: Cumulative deficit, worst season and remaining restoration debt.
objectives.across_futures: Upper 90th percentile, with drought and industrial-demand sensitivities.
objectives.observation_and_truth: Gauge estimates and ecological observations inform decisions; the scoring model retains true conditions and observation uncertainty.
objectives.terminal_failure: Ecological damage and restoration obligations persist beyond a fiscal or political failure and beyond the scoring date.
objectives.coverage_gate: Blocked until stream-flow thresholds, hydrology, industrial demand and restoration mechanisms are specified. Published environmental tables do not supply all these coefficients.

objectives.name: Partner prosperity and resilience
objectives.beneficiary: Residents of one selected partner, with separate reporting for vulnerable groups.
objectives.geography: Japan, China, Korea, Gulf, Philippine crown or a Russian/Siberian successor as individually selected.
objectives.definition: Apply a separately scoped real-consumption/person contract to the partner and report its fiscal, banking and autonomy conditions. Never add its GDP or reserves to Pacifica's sovereign resources.
objectives.unit: Partner-specific constant-price currency per resident; show comparison indices only with declared price/conversion rules.
objectives.time_aggregation: Cumulative real consumption/person and adverse-year level for each partner.
objectives.across_futures: Lower 10th percentile per selected partner component; no automatic aggregate across countries.
objectives.observation_and_truth: Partner accounts and observations remain distinct. Benefits to Pacifican lenders are not evidence of partner welfare.
objectives.terminal_failure: Track partner population and successor institutions after default or regime change, with explicit continuation uncertainty.
objectives.coverage_gate: Requires partner national/household accounts, population and independent behavior. Network GDP is a diagnostic proxy, not this objective.

diagnostics.name: Income and ownership
measures: Nominal and real GDP by territory

diagnostics.name: Relative position
measures: Core/Union real-output ratio on a common price basis
Cost and time to discharge or decline a named commitment

diagnostics.name: Governance and measurement
measures: Beneficiaries and harms excluded by a metric

constraint_types.ENGINE_INVARIANT: A calculation or accounting violation is a model error. Diagnose it and withhold affected rankings; keep the error count visible.
constraint_types.ACTION_PRECONDITION: A condition checked at a declared stage. Actor-visible eligibility uses permitted observations; actual authority, resources and consent resolve at adjudication. An attempt may fail without leaking hidden information beforehand.
constraint_types.POLICY_BOUND: A limit on Pacifica's choices. Record breaches caused by shocks separately from deliberate commitments.
constraint_types.OUTCOME_BOUND: A realized outcome limit. Keep violating futures in the sample and mark the policy's feasibility and loss.
constraint_types.EVIDENCE_GATE: A ranking or measure is unavailable until definitions, mechanisms and data cover the intended claim.
constraint_types.LEGAL_REQUIREMENT: Required for lawful execution; a selected supported breach family records unauthorized execution and consequences without inventing lawful title or consent.
constraint_types.PHYSICAL_LIMIT: Actual resource/technology/time limits constrain execution in every profile; perceived feasibility may differ.
constraint_types.AUTHORIAL_CONSTRAINT: A locked premise of the selected experiment, distinct from in-world law. Any permitted change is an explicit premise branch.

constraints.name: Conservation and balanced accounts
constraints.rule: Every cash flow, loan, equity issue, transfer and inventory movement has counterparties, ownership and dates. Public/private/foreign subscriptions reconcile; loans are assets and liabilities, not new output. Borrowing is not income and avoided spending is not extra GDP.
constraints.threshold: Zero unexplained residual beyond a declared numeric rounding tolerance.
constraints.applies: Every mode and actor account.
constraints.breach: Model error; retain failed rollout status and diagnose before ranking.

constraints.name: Resource and time feasibility
constraints.rule: Procurement, mobilisation, training, transport, repair and construction consume scarce resources and elapsed time. Shared capacity cannot serve two uses at once; imports require supply, shipping and settlement.
constraints.threshold: Demand cannot exceed allocated usable capacity; no retroactive deployment or instant technology.
constraints.applies: All actions and actor response policies.
constraints.breach: Allow an observation-consistent attempt, then adjudicate rejection, delay, partial execution or failure; no impossible capacity or double allocation is realized.

constraints.name: Information available at the time
constraints.rule: Policies use dated observations, beliefs and legally available own-account information. Hidden actor preferences and future draws are inaccessible. Freeze actor policies before simultaneous decisions resolve. Eligibility masks, previews, validation messages and response-search knowledge obey the same observation boundary; private policy code is not public by default.
constraints.threshold: No observation timestamp later than the decision; no access to random seeds or hidden future states.
constraints.applies: Pacifica, independent actors and optimizer.
constraints.breach: Invalid policy/model information leak; assess the affected run as an error.

constraints.name: Authority and valid consent
constraints.rule: Appropriation, legislation, crown-land rights, treaty ratification and foreign acceptance require the competent bodies under the law in force. A proposal may proceed to negotiation; the executive cannot supply the other party's vote.
constraints.threshold: All required authorities valid before binding execution.
constraints.applies: Conduct bindings apply to named actors/action families. lawful rejects actual unauthorized execution; apparent_authority and breach_exploration require separate registered mechanisms and consequences.
constraints.breach: Perceived authorization, actual legality, intentional violation and discovery remain distinct. Preserve prior breach intervals after cure, and never manufacture consent.

constraints.name: Territorial and financial perimeter
constraints.rule: Separate core, Hawaiian/Philippine crown, local and common budgets from sovereign partners. Foreign gold purchases create transactions and reserves; foreign production remains foreign GDP. Concessions, loans, bases and customs commissions do not transfer sovereignty.
constraints.threshold: One declared owner and jurisdiction per asset/flow; explicit consolidation eliminations.
constraints.applies: Every objective, actor, action and comparison.
constraints.breach: Model error or unsupported aggregation; withhold the misleading measure.

constraints.name: Operative employment premise
constraints.rule: Use professional contractors and directly managed, paid crews for the corrected Company/construction premise. Kolyma uses free, well-paid workers. Do not restore the superseded bonded-gang mechanism or invent a productivity/cost discount.
constraints.threshold: No coercive-labour subsidy or invented uplift from CR-031-R1.
constraints.applies: Applicable construction and mining models; lawful recruitment, local rights and voluntary worker decisions remain explicit.
constraints.breach: Unsupported mechanism; replace it before evaluating the policy.

constraints.name: Peacetime military and overseas spending
constraints.rule: Pacifica's own military/overseas expenditure divided by North American GDP must remain within the planning ceiling, with current/capital items and accounting period declared.
constraints.applies: Peacetime planning. Continuation after 1900 is a convention, not an independently proved sustainable level.
constraints.breach: Mark policy breach and show response options. An actual conflict may invoke a registered exception with costs and expiry; the optimizer cannot relabel spending as war to escape the bound.

constraints.name: Public interest burden
constraints.rule: Public interest due divided by ordinary public revenue stays within the planning ceiling on a consistent fiscal perimeter.
constraints.applies: All scored years unless a declared temporary crisis exception is selected.
constraints.breach: Keep the path; record duration, debt dynamics and fiscal responses. Falling revenue can cause a breach without a new spending decision.

constraints.name: Public debt burden
constraints.rule: Gross public debt divided by North American GDP stays within the planning ceiling. Disclose guaranteed exposure and partner/common liabilities separately rather than netting them away.
constraints.applies: Same public and GDP perimeters across all policies.
constraints.breach: Keep the path and flag severity/duration. GDP collapse and exchange-rate changes remain possible causes.

constraints.name: Treasury cash protection
constraints.rule: Do not authorize discretionary new commitments that consume the protected cash buffer after existing essential services, debt service and already committed draws are scheduled.
constraints.threshold_unit: Months of unavoidable public cash outlays.
constraints.applies: Draft planning default only; the author must select the buffer and essential-service definition. This is not a source-derived historical rule.
constraints.breach: Reject or reduce the new commitment; an external shock can still exhaust the buffer and must remain a scored fiscal loss.

constraints.name: Bank capital and external settlement
constraints.rule: Reconcile bank losses, owner write-offs, new equity, domestic liquidity and foreign-currency funding by institution/currency. A yen liquidity advance cannot discharge a dollar payment. Financing commitments are not automatically drawn cash.
constraints.threshold: Use separately approved solvency/cover rules. The baseline Japan-rescue design retains six weeks of imports; test its necessity and alternatives as model assumptions.
constraints.applies: Financial stability and rescue proposals, including Japan and Union responses.
constraints.breach: Simulate run, default, devaluation or restructuring; do not declare a rescue successful merely because a credit line was offered.

constraints.name: Mission sustainment and civilian capacity
constraints.rule: Deploy only forces that can be supported through the actual rail/sea/port network and stockpiles while satisfying the campaign's civilian allocations and consent conditions.
constraints.threshold: Select a mission-specific readiness and sustainment test. The 28,000-person contingent and 50,000 troops in two weeks are source MODEL/proposed tests, not proved capacity.
constraints.applies: Siberian or other commitments only when the relevant geography and agreement exist.
constraints.breach: Resolve attempts against actual access, stocks and capacity, allowing registered failure/partial/delay outcomes; profile selection cannot create resources or available transport.

constraints.name: Human-loss ceiling
constraints.rule: Specify an acceptable cumulative-death limit, civilian/military breakdown and maximum tolerated risk of exceeding it; include affected foreign populations.
constraints.threshold_unit: Deaths and accepted exceedance probability, both to select.
constraints.applies: Any campaign claiming a human-cost feasibility result.
constraints.breach: Retain the loss, mark the policy against the selected bound and show the causes. No numeric feasibility claim until the threshold and coverage exist.

constraints.name: Environmental duties and restoration
constraints.rule: Apply water, land, reef and restoration obligations when the relevant law or agreement is in force. Waimanu protection and the Lands and Waters Charter are baseline outcomes, not automatic enactments in every generated future.
constraints.threshold: Selected minimum stream flows, discharge limits and restoration duties; engineering values remain open.
constraints.applies: Affected projects and jurisdictions; no imported modern standard by assumption.
constraints.breach: Block an unlawful permit in the lawful profile; otherwise record litigation, damage, compensation and restoration liabilities.

constraints.name: Gulf admission and independent choice
constraints.rule: Admission requires the five general measures and both parity tests for 25 consecutive years, plus the other compact conditions and competent consent. General measures are infant mortality, literacy, real wages, homicide and typhoid against the specified weakest former-territory comparator. The examination comparison is the Defense Law's joint medical-and-literacy test for twenty-year-olds.
constraints.threshold: Joint medical/literacy pass-rate ratio for Black/freedmen twenty-year-olds versus white twenty-year-olds >=0.95; Black/freedmen-to-white infant-mortality ratio <=1.05; registers cover >=90% of the specified records; all required measures sustain the 25-year rule.
constraints.applies: Only if admission is proposed. Carry inherited streaks, definitions, revenue/debt/standards and consent requirements in the initial state.
constraints.breach: Admission unavailable; assistance, trade or defence cooperation may continue. Baseline replay preserves non-membership through 1932; discovery cannot bypass the tests or force Gulf acceptance.

constraints.name: Korean sovereignty and local rights
constraints.rule: Respect Korea's independent guaranteed status after the applicable settlement and its agreed economic/military/transit rights; distinguish Chinese railway ownership, Japanese running rights and local land rights. New arrangements require competent consent.
constraints.threshold: No action may silently turn an access right into annexation or extinguish local rights.
constraints.applies: Lawful actions after the relevant instruments exist. Discovery may simulate another actor's breach and Pacifica's response.
constraints.breach: Reject an unsupported legal effect; model coercion or violation as an adverse event with its actual legal status and consequences.
constraints.profile_behavior: Rights remain legally defined in every profile. A supported physically possible breach may affect control or access but cannot create lawful title, consent or ownership by declaration.

constraints.name: Fork history and open futures
constraints.rule: Freeze the selected history and state only through the fork. After it, government survival, war/peace, victories, treaty acceptance and crises arise from actions, mechanisms and chance. Preserve applicable identity and institutional rules unless the experiment explicitly permits a coherent departure. Decision forks preserve the established prefix. An author-imposed future event is possible only as a separately labeled conditional intervention, never ordinary discovery evidence.
constraints.threshold: No future storyline fact used as an unconditional success override in discovery.
constraints.applies: All comparisons; scenario packages declare different earlier forks and changed premises.
constraints.breach: Misclassified fixture or scenario; remove the override or label the result a conditional replay.

constraints.name: Terminal obligations and failures
constraints.rule: Report post-1932 debt service, guarantees, maintenance, restoration and treaty exposure. Defeat, default and political collapse receive defined continuation/terminal-loss treatment; computational errors are a separate status.
constraints.threshold: No dropped failed path or omitted liability; unresolved continuation produces bounds and ranking uncertainty.
constraints.applies: Every scored trajectory.
constraints.breach: Policy ranking provisional or unavailable until the unresolved liability/failure effect is bounded. Do not assign invented point penalties.

constraints.name: Evidence and metric coverage
constraints.rule: A metric needs its mechanism, units, territory, beneficiary, price basis, source/assumption record and uncertainty treatment. Missing data is unknown, not zero. Mechanism applicability is checked during evolution; selected provisional continuations propagate conditional status without removing paths from the population.
constraints.threshold: Every active objective and material constraint has usable coverage or an explicitly selected, labelled proxy.
constraints.applies: Enabling objectives, comparisons and policy recommendations.
constraints.breach: Disable the unsupported measure or qualify a conditional experiment; do not rank an unsupported policy as best.

constraints.name: Risk and joint feasibility
constraints.rule: Select risk tolerances for outcome bounds and evaluate the joint event that all selected constraints hold. Report sample uncertainty and held-out results; correlated violations cannot be assessed by multiplying marginal pass rates.
constraints.threshold_unit: Author-selected tolerated exceedance risks and joint-success requirement.
constraints.applies: Probability-weighted experiments only. Unweighted plausible-world experiments report scenario fractions, robustness and regret.
constraints.breach: Keep all worlds and report infeasibility or unresolved uncertainty. No calibrated-probability claim without a justified world distribution.

actors.name: Pacifica executive
actors.activation: All pilot paths; officeholder and legal powers depend on the fork and valid succession.
actors.authority: Proposes budgets, credit, diplomacy, laws and authorized deployments; cannot supply legislative, crown or foreign consent.
interests: Author-selected objectives subject to law and resources; no assumed preference for dominance at any human cost.
actors.evidence_needed: Map executive prerogative and delegated powers by date; the exact control mask remains a design choice.

actors.name: Senate and Chamber
actors.activation: All paths; instantiate chambers, blocs and material county interests separately.
actors.authority: Legislation, appropriation and applicable treaty/succession consent under the current constitutional rules.
responses: Demand audit or indemnity within applicable law
actors.evidence_needed: Source vote thresholds and chamber roles; model blocs and bargaining without assuming a purchased vote always passes.

actors.name: Reserve Bank
actors.activation: All paths once the selected initial state establishes the institution.
actors.authority: Monetary, liquidity and regulatory actions within its charter; exact delegation between government and bank is open.
actors.evidence_needed: Charter, ownership of reserves, collateral valuation, currency liabilities and government approval requirements.

actors.name: Hawaiian institutions and land custodians
actors.activation: All pilot paths, with legislature/crown structure changing only through valid branch events.
actors.authority: Hawaiian legislature and ʻAha Aliʻi exercise their own powers; Crown/kuleana land custody is distinct from county administration and Realm regulation.
resources: Own budget and lawful land/lease decisions
actors.evidence_needed: Separate institutional actors when their preferences differ; Puʻuloa rent amount remains unspecified.

actors.name: Philippine institutions
actors.activation: Dependency institutions at the fork; separate crown/Cortes and its rights activate only through valid branch events.
actors.authority: Own budget, legislature and military powers according to the legal stage; consent and accession rites are separate from Realm votes.
actors.evidence_needed: Date-specific powers, local constituencies, Philippine loan/service account and population boundaries.

actors.name: Pacifica county and community actors
actors.activation: Instantiate affected counties, local administrations and rights-holding communities rather than one national public.
actors.authority: County powers follow organic law; Indigenous and community rights need their own instruments and representation.
actors.evidence_needed: County fiscal accounts, public measures and representative institutions; official franchise is not the full affected population.

actors.name: Banks, savers and private financiers
actors.activation: Instantiate by owner, jurisdiction, currency, maturity and exposure; Pacifican and foreign books stay distinct.
actors.authority: Own lending, subscriptions, collateral and funding decisions; government cannot allocate private saving as public cash.
actors.evidence_needed: Bank-level or bounded representative balance sheets, funding capacity, maturity/currency mismatch and collateral overlap.

actors.name: Champions, contractors and trading firms
actors.activation: Instantiate material firms/sectors in Pacifica and partners, with ownership and management separated.
actors.authority: Private production, employment, investment and contracting; Crown equity does not confer all profits or automatic compliance.
actors.evidence_needed: Capacity, delays, wages, costs and ownership; CR-031-R1 paid professional construction premise, with no invented productivity multiplier.

actors.name: Japan's civilian government and imperial institutions
actors.activation: All pilot paths; cabinet, Diet, court and competent treaty authorities are separate decision roles when material.
actors.authority: Domestic government, treaty/budget decisions and national institutions; common powers exist only under a valid compact.
responses: Restrain or fail to restrain military actors
actors.evidence_needed: Time-dependent institutions, bargaining alternatives and acceptance conditions; no assumed permanent alignment.

actors.name: Japanese military factions
actors.activation: Instantiate army, navy treaty faction and opposing naval/army groups when their command/resources differ.
actors.authority: National commands and, where authorized, common or reserved commands; the home army is not automatically the common government's army.
responses: Disobey or attempt a rupture as an explicitly modelled adverse action
actors.evidence_needed: Command chains, faction support and warning indicators; avoid one deterministic 'Japan loyalty' variable.

actors.name: Partner monetary and stabilization authorities
actors.activation: Instantiate BOJ, foreign reserve authorities and stabilization agencies where supported by the selected branch.
actors.authority: Domestic currency/liquidity and authorized external arrangements; keep each authority and fiscal guarantor separate.
responses: Change or suspend parity when legally possible
actors.evidence_needed: Currency-specific balance sheets, actual reserves, loss allocation and approval rules; BOJ yen is not foreign exchange.

actors.name: China's central government
actors.activation: Qing or successor government according to the generated constitutional/political path.
actors.authority: Chinese sovereignty, central fiscal and treaty powers subject to actual regional reach.
resources: Customs and other revenues within actual control
actors.evidence_needed: Government capacity and legitimacy by region; no guaranteed reunification or automatic client status.

actors.name: Manchurian and other Chinese regional authorities
actors.activation: Instantiate relevant administrations, military leaders, railway managers and successors; activation follows actual control.
actors.authority: Regional forces, railway cooperation and local administration within their actual legal and coercive reach.
actors.evidence_needed: Who can authorize versus physically enable transit; separate Chinese ownership from Japanese running rights and temporary boards.

actors.name: Korean government and institutions
actors.activation: All pilot paths under the selected independent guarantee and rights instruments.
actors.authority: Own sovereignty, consent and administration; economic predominance or transit rights do not create annexation.
interests: Terms for workers and foreign concessions
actors.evidence_needed: Treaty scope, competent consent and economic accounts; Korean workers retain individual agency.

actors.name: Government controlling the Russian centre
actors.activation: Imperial, constitutional, provisional, Bolshevik or other successor according to the path; do not activate mutually exclusive governments as one omniscient actor.
actors.authority: Actual central authority, resources and treaty capacity; contested regions remain separate.
actors.evidence_needed: Regime-specific institutions, factions, resource access and transitions; Pacifica cannot select a Russian election or regime by action.

actors.name: Russian opposition and competing movements
actors.activation: Instantiate Bolshevik, White, constitutional, regional and other material movements when present, with separate agendas.

actor_rules.independence: Separate budgets, information, feasible actions, objectives, approval processes and memory. Independent does not mean uncorrelated or irrational.
actor_rules.templates: Template records require distinct actor instances with legal names, date range, jurisdiction, resources and evidence; they are not single omniscient collective agents.
actor_rules.response_models: Start with interpretable acceptance thresholds and bounded decision rules. Assess alternative bargaining, capacity and faction models; no calibrated response probability is supplied by this catalog.
actor_rules.simultaneous_decisions: Take observations from the frozen decision state, collect actions, then resolve interactions. Explicit negotiating rounds use their own declared order.
actor_rules.state_changes: Formation, dissolution, succession and changing control update the actor graph and obligations without silently deleting population, assets, claims or losses.
minimum_refusal_tests: An unaffordable or unacceptable offer is refused.
An ally can condition or withdraw support.
A lender can decline or stop renewing.
Domestic chambers can reject a treaty.
A regional/local actor can disagree with a nominal sovereign.
Peaceful cooperation does not imply political subordination.
actor_rules.llm_role: May help draft reviewed actor assumptions and explanations. Numerical adjudication uses registered, reproducible model rules; no new runtime coefficient is invented by a language model.
actor_rules.intention: Selected character goals, beliefs, persistent plans and personal commitments are distinct from institutional objectives. Use dated roles and existing character IDs/crosswalks; updates require registered observations/rules and source/assumption provenance.
actor_rules.information_boundary: The same permitted information controls policy inputs, eligibility masks, previews, pre-disclosure errors and fallback choices. Adjudicator-only truth is disclosed only through registered observation channels.
actor_rules.response_knowledge: Declare whether counterparties know public Pacifica commitments or a policy class; private policy code and future orders remain hidden. State unilateral/joint response assumptions and disallow incompatible reply combinations.
actor_rules.decision_context: Every choice binds person/collective, represented institution or personal capacity, dated role/authority, resource owners, control mask, information and actual decision procedure. Institutional optimization cannot silently suppress enabled personal goals.
actor_rules.decision_reasons: Record only goals, beliefs and trade-offs actually used by the decision procedure, its considered alternatives and randomness. Author overrides are explicit; officeholder changes preserve institutional liabilities and use declared private-state transfer.

actions.name: Propose and execute a public budget
actions.preconditions: Competent legislative approval for changes; existing duties, local/crown budgets and essential services mapped.
actions.costs_and_timing: Revenue arrives on its collection schedule; services use labor/materials. Tax and spending changes affect households and firms with lags.
possible_responses: Change investment, employment or tax compliance
actions.realized_effects: Authorized taxes and payments; endogenous service, demand and capacity effects.
failure_modes: Cutting essential services to inflate cash

actions.name: Issue or restructure public debt
actions.preconditions: Legal authority, disclosed existing debt and feasible investor funding; refinancing cannot erase liabilities.
actions.costs_and_timing: Market subscription and settlement precede usable cash; fees, interest and repayments continue past the horizon.
actions.realized_effects: Actual subscribed debt and cash; creditor losses or maturity changes by agreement.
failure_modes: Future debt hidden by terminal date

actions.name: Offer public or syndicated credit
actions.preconditions: Borrower exists and can legally accept; public appropriation and funding capacity; private participation remains voluntary.
actions.costs_and_timing: Commitment reserves exposure; cash only at accepted draws. Administration, credit losses and debt service follow actual schedules.
actions.realized_effects: Separate public, private and foreign claims; borrower investment only after real resources are obtained.
failure_modes: Treating the whole syndicate as Treasury property

actions.name: Offer a guarantee or contingent commitment
actions.preconditions: Authority to guarantee; disclosed potential funding calls and correlated exposure.
actions.costs_and_timing: No fictitious initial purchase payment. Fees and expected exposure differ from cash drawn on a realized call.
actions.realized_effects: Contingent liability and realized calls with recoveries; credible guarantees may affect financing terms.
failure_modes: Counting commitment as both cash and debt twice

actions.name: Propose bank stabilization
actions.preconditions: Bank examination and distinct fiscal/central-bank authority; identify solvency and currency gaps separately.
actions.costs_and_timing: Audits/moratoria take time; equity, collateralized liquidity and foreign exchange use different balance sheets and resources.
actions.realized_effects: Recapitalized banks and settlement capacity only to the extent actual losses, collateral and draws support them.
failure_modes: A reopened bank with no import buffer

actions.name: Propose reserve or monetary arrangements
actions.preconditions: Reserve/monetary authorities and any required legislation or treaty approve; reserves owned and liabilities measured.
actions.costs_and_timing: Settlement, credibility, valuation and trade effects occur over time; changing parity redistributes gains and losses.
actions.realized_effects: Actual convertibility/settlement rules and endogenous reserve flows; no free gold creation.
failure_modes: Fixed exchange gains assumed without counterpart losses

actions.name: Invest in productive infrastructure
actions.preconditions: Land/permit/consent, engineering prerequisites, labor, equipment and financing; allocation against competing projects.
actions.costs_and_timing: Design and construction precede usable capacity; cost overruns, imported inputs and maintenance remain explicit.
possible_responses: Use or underuse the completed asset
actions.realized_effects: Ports, rails, power, water or communications capacity only after completion; productivity/demand effects follow registered mechanisms.
failure_modes: Using wartime rail paths also promised to civilians

actions.name: Fund research and industrial capability
actions.preconditions: Period-available scientific/industrial prerequisites and lawful patents/contracts; firms and researchers participate.
actions.costs_and_timing: Research may fail; prototype, tooling, trained crews and production take separate time and capacity.
actions.realized_effects: Uncertain technical progress and usable production capacity; foreign competitors can learn and respond.
failure_modes: Inventing a construction uplift from CR-031-R1

actions.name: Expand skills, health and lawful labor supply
actions.preconditions: Applicable entry and employment law, budgets, training capacity, voluntary household choices and source-country consent where required.
actions.costs_and_timing: Costs include passage, housing, schools and services; health/skill/retention effects take time. Distinguish gross arrivals and additional population.
actions.realized_effects: Cohorts, skill, health and production effects with age/sex/residency and remittances tracked.
failure_modes: Counting migrants and attributed descendants twice
Exporting all harm beyond the scoring population

actions.name: Procure, maintain and prepare forces
actions.preconditions: Appropriation, yard/factory capacity, crews, technology and input supply; procurement and maintenance compete for resources.
actions.costs_and_timing: Lead times, training, depreciation, maintenance and fuel remain recurring; inventory is not automatically ready.
actions.realized_effects: Mission-capable units and sustainable readiness only after completion and integration.

actions.name: Commit, escort or reposition forces
actions.preconditions: Authorization, transit/basing rights, readiness and actual sustainment; coalition national command powers respected.
actions.costs_and_timing: Mobilisation and travel delay; consumption, wear, casualties and ongoing support priced along the route.
actions.realized_effects: Changed security, deterrence, operational outcomes and human costs adjudicated by the registered model.
failure_modes: An ally's army treated as Pacifica's property

actions.name: Negotiate access, transit or guarantees
actions.preconditions: Competent owners, sovereigns, local rights and existing treaties identified; Pacifica can propose terms but cannot supply their acceptance.
actions.costs_and_timing: Diplomatic time, compensation and infrastructure/service obligations; rights become usable only on effective terms.
actions.realized_effects: Consent-valid, practically usable rights and obligations; sovereignty changes only through a separately lawful event.
failure_modes: Signing as proof of route availability
Ignoring local rights or rival guarantees

actions.name: Offer crisis mediation or peace terms
actions.preconditions: Case-specific roster of every indispensable party and veto; independent willingness/capacity to negotiate.
actions.costs_and_timing: Negotiation rounds, travel/information delay, verification and promised support; continued war can consume resources during talks.
actions.realized_effects: Armistice/peace only if parties agree and implement; later compliance and renewed-war risk stay endogenous.
failure_modes: Peace with the institutions and debt windfalls of prolonged war

actions.name: Condition new credit and civilian conversion
actions.preconditions: Separate existing contractual obligations from future offers; fiscal/private consent for the conversion package.
actions.costs_and_timing: Lost export demand, loan losses, plant conversion, employment and diplomacy are modelled; ending new credit is not confiscating existing private claims.
actions.realized_effects: Actual credit/order changes and bargaining effects; no guaranteed settlement date.

actions.name: Change trade, supply or transport restrictions
actions.preconditions: Actual authority over goods/transport and a feasible enforcement mechanism; partners and private owners remain distinct.
actions.costs_and_timing: Revenue loss, substitution, evasion, enforcement, retaliation and civilian effects; reductions cannot exceed Pacifica's actual control.
actions.realized_effects: Changed feasible resources and incentives, with induced shortages and political responses.
failure_modes: Assuming an oil threat guarantees obedience
Treating Gulf output as Pacifican stock

actions.name: Propose a compact or common institution
actions.preconditions: Each party's domestic consent and fiscal capacity; internal Ka Lōkahi and external Concord roles remain distinct.
actions.costs_and_timing: Negotiation and ratification delay; continuing common costs and enforcement. A peaceful partnership can use a different lawful structure.
actions.realized_effects: Only the functions and resources actually delegated; separate national armies, reserves and citizenship retained as applicable.
failure_modes: Three internal crowns counted as three Concord parties

actions.name: Propose constitutional or succession change
actions.preconditions: Competent institutions and applicable amendment/succession rules; living officeholders and individual choices retain agency.
actions.costs_and_timing: Legislative/plebiscite/calendar delay and political opposition; earlier accession is an explicitly different scenario package, not an unexplained date switch.
actions.realized_effects: Valid changes only after conditions hold, with downstream powers, ages, obligations and character chronology adjusted coherently.
failure_modes: Choosing a relative's death as a policy parameter

actions.name: Provide relief and reconstruction support
actions.preconditions: Funding, local permission, transport and eligible supplies; affected communities can accept or contest implementation.
actions.costs_and_timing: Delivery bottlenecks and time, replacement costs and recurring services; debt relief is distinct from new cash.
actions.realized_effects: Delivered goods, restored assets and health/welfare effects under explicit mechanisms; gratitude does not guarantee alignment.
failure_modes: Aid counted on commitment rather than delivery
Grants also counted as lender assets

actions.name: Negotiate concession or equity investment
actions.preconditions: Seller/sovereign/local rights, valid company authority and actual investor funding. Proposed Company terms remain branch assumptions.
actions.costs_and_timing: Acquisition and construction draws, wages, supply, operating costs, risk and delayed income; minority ownership is not all output.
actions.realized_effects: Actual equity/contractual claims and income by owner; foreign production and employment stay in their jurisdiction.
failure_modes: Kolyma or Company output booked as core GDP
Treating a stake as immediate dividends

actions.name: Arrange a gold or reserve-asset purchase
actions.preconditions: Available physical supply, legal purchase authority, transport and actual payment/credit counterpart.
actions.costs_and_timing: Extraction and delivery precede receipt; assay, freight, insurance and settlement costs; bank credit has an offsetting liability.
actions.realized_effects: Owned reserve asset and matching paid/credited consideration; no automatic public revenue or domestic mining output.
failure_modes: Reserve purchase counted as free fiscal income
Same deposit counted as unencumbered public cash

actions.name: Adopt environmental and public-land measures
actions.preconditions: Relevant legislature, land custodians, existing titles and engineering alternatives; county administration does not transfer Crown ownership.
actions.costs_and_timing: Foregone uses, public works, monitoring and restoration are priced; long-lived ecological and financial effects continue.
actions.realized_effects: Actual flows, discharge, land use and funded restoration; refinancing changes cash timing, not physical resource cost.
failure_modes: A rate reduction creating free electricity
Preserving a reef by exporting all damage

actions.name: Propose an oil or commodity coordination agreement
actions.preconditions: Each producer/government's competent consent; actual market supply/demand and enforcement capacity.
actions.costs_and_timing: Revenue, consumer/input-price effects, quota compliance, substitute supply and political reaction vary over time.
actions.realized_effects: Endogenous output and prices within a supported market model; producer prosperity and consumer costs are separate.
failure_modes: Guaranteed price support without demand/supply response

actions.name: Commission measurement, audit or verification
actions.preconditions: Access, competent authority and measurement capability. Independence and publication rules affect credibility.
actions.costs_and_timing: Staff, inspection, collection and delay; observation accuracy is bounded, never perfect foresight.
actions.realized_effects: Dated observations and evidence quality; other actors update their own beliefs. Underlying truth is separate from official publication.

actions.name: Wait, revise, reduce or exit a commitment
actions.preconditions: Lawful cancellation/exit terms and residual duties; inaction is available but does not cancel existing appropriations, treaties or maintenance.
actions.costs_and_timing: Time passes, opportunities change, notices cost resources and withdrawal may create losses, liabilities or political reactions.
actions.realized_effects: Actual released or committed resources, credibility changes and continuing security/human outcomes.
failure_modes: Waiting with no opponent or economic response

action_rules.schema: Every attempt references an immutable DecisionRecord/DecisionContext, observation snapshot, typed parameters and actor/action-family conduct binding. Adjudication records perceived authority, actual legality, independent response, reservations, disposition and disclosure separately.
action_rules.parameter_bounds: Currency, quantity, maturity, tax and capacity bounds come from the current state, applicable law and registered evidence. Offer shares lie in [0,1], amounts are nonnegative, but those ranges do not establish affordable or acceptable terms.
action_rules.partial_approval: A proposal may be negotiated before approval. A refusal can consume time and cost but creates no fictional treaty or private subscription.
action_rules.bundles: Linked actions reference the same financing, capacity and agreements. Financing a project does not separately create a second capital stock or duplicate spending.
action_rules.default_enablement: All action families remain search_enabled=false. Coverage review must supply the active ontology, actual/observed preconditions, ownership/resources, applicability and consequences. Breach families need independent enabling and consequence checks. Apparent-authority variants also require separate enabling, observation and consequence checks.
action_rules.resolution: Apply due events and deliver reports; update beliefs/plans; collect attempts from frozen permitted observations; adjudicate actual conditions and independent replies; reserve/allocate resources; commit atomic or declared partial bundles; settle implementation; disclose authorized observations; check applicability and invariants.
action_rules.failure: Rejected proposals and adverse outcomes remain in the trace; computational errors have a separate status.

profile_semantics.binding: Explicit actor ID or declared actor set plus action family, effective interval and rule version. Resolve overlaps by declared precedence; missing bindings fail configuration. Profile categories are an upper bound: each exceptional action variant also needs explicit enabling and consequence coverage.
profile_semantics.lawful: Permits lawful_execution. Actor attempts and visible menus obey actor information; adjudication rejects actual unlawful execution without leaking concealed reasons before permitted disclosure.
profile_semantics.apparent_authority: Adds mistaken_authority_execution to lawful execution: a registered physically possible but actually unauthorized act may execute when the actor believes it authorized under the pinned credibility rule. Actual legality is independently adjudicated; valid authority produces an ordinary lawful outcome.
profile_semantics.breach_exploration: Adds intentional_breach_execution to the apparent_authority set. Only explicitly enabled exceptional variants with supported consequences may execute. The actor may still act lawfully, honour an agreement or decline to act; permission never compels misconduct.
profile_semantics.classification: Adjudication resolves actual legality independently of the profile name. An actually authorized act uses lawful_execution even if the actor misunderstood its status; intention/perceived authority are separate recorded dimensions. An actually unauthorized act requires the applicable mistaken-authority or intentional-breach category and its registered rule. Unknown/disputed material truth follows its resolution policy; only permitted hypotheses may resolve it, otherwise the dependent adjudication is unsupported. A nonbinding personal promise violation is classified by its actual legal status, not the word breach; legally permissible conduct or conduct with no applicable legal restriction may use lawful_execution while social consequences remain separately modeled.
profile_semantics.mixed_world: Pacifica can be lawful while a counterparty has broader permissions. Independent procedures choose actions; no profile creates consent, title, resources or favourable outcomes.

action_rules.resource_arbitration: Register priority/tie rules, reservation release/expiry and bundle atomicity; actor order, module order and worker scheduling cannot silently allocate shared cash, collateral or capacity.

rules: Review discretionary commitments when cash falls below the selected buffer.

review_decisions.proposal: Review the draft Q10/Q90 summaries, three-month cash proposal and source 4%/15%/30% conventions; choose loss limits and exceedance risks.
Optimize the executive agenda and authorized actions; retain institutional and foreign consent. Instantiate all indispensable negotiating parties.
Select the narrow R0 financing/commitment dilemma first within the broader 1904–1932 campaign; include selected beliefs/plans, supported consequences and the author usefulness protocol.
Obtain the consumption/price bridge, resource/logistics data, actor response cases, human-cost model and terminal-liability treatment before claiming strategic rankings.
Use common-start policy contests for search; separately label authored scenario packages, including early accession and prescribed peace outcomes.

review_decisions.decision: Approve author evaluation and search contracts
review_decisions.proposal: Predeclare actual author tasks, manual comparison and time/repair limits; require retention, branching, replay and explicit usefulness acceptance with typed evidence.

comparison_rules: Distinguish a common-start policy contest from a comparison of authored scenario packages with different initial premises.

The baseline and alternatives do not share every 1904–1905 war assumption; C/D also change accession and its dependencies. Either normalize such assumptions explicitly or report the difference as part of the package.
Keep endogenous conflict, financial crises, regime transitions and ally responses free to differ under policies. Match only exogenous draws where the comparison design supports it.
Do not grant peaceful paths war-derived debts, concessions or common institutions for free; do not reward a war solely for increasing a relative GDP ratio by destroying other economies.
Frozen fixtures are deterministic accounting references, not observations of historical probabilities. Matched-downturn aliases are not independent samples.
Keep strategic objectives separate from narrative selection. Author bookmarks survive Pareto pruning without changing assessments.
Distinguish decision, premise and imposed_event branches, recording prefix, effective/information times and full decision-state reconstruction.
Preserve selection denominators for targeted story samples; assess frozen selected policies on fresh unconditioned worlds before reporting ordinary success distributions.
Profile changes and provisional continuations remain explicit; unsupported/conditional paths cannot be silently pooled into stronger rankings.
Report alternative structural-model assessments separately unless an explicit weighting contract supports aggregation.

100 root worlds with 20 unsupported paths and 20 provisional child continuations remain 100 original policy-world evaluations: 80 supported and 20 unsupported. There are 120 logical branch executions before retries. The 20 continuations form a selected conditional population, not 20 added independent worlds.
Open story exploration requires no strategic objective set. Candidate selection precedes pruning; story signatures use supported choices/conflicts rather than numeric jitter.

Narrative search separates supported existence, policy reliability and minimum premise change; unresolved temporal results and no-match-within-budget never imply successful completion or impossibility.
Every calculation/evaluation/branch references the canonical resolved-experiment identity; root-world matching remains separate and requires compatible external draw semantics.
Default story claims require actor-generated decisions throughout assessed lineage. Overrides/imposed events remain conditional even when their downstream mechanics are supported.
Open proposals have an explicit budget independent of strategic fitness; a pre-inserted dominated path cannot establish discovery.
R0 author evidence separates plausibility, controller generation and an isolated one-action consequence contrast with unchanged continuation rules, plus a low-effect case.

review_examples.name: Credit offer refused
review_examples.setup: A borrower rejects a public-credit offer or private lenders will not subscribe.
review_examples.expected: Only incurred proposal costs/time are booked. No loan asset, borrower investment, alignment or successful treaty appears.

review_examples.name: Rail access withdrawn
review_examples.setup: A Chinese authority withdraws or cannot implement required transit during a supported commitment.
review_examples.expected: Independent response changes transport, stocks, mission feasibility and human/security outcomes; the engine cannot substitute an unowned route.

review_examples.name: Peace without war windfalls
review_examples.setup: A mediation policy avoids general war.
review_examples.expected: Peaceful production and partner independence may improve. Entente war claims, wartime territorial gains and rescue-driven institutional concessions are absent unless separately generated and paid for.

review_examples.name: Failed or illegal compact
review_examples.setup: The Senate refuses a common-institution treaty.
review_examples.expected: Lawful mode leaves the compact unratified. A selected supported breach variant can model physically possible unauthorized execution with independent resistance and consequences; later remedy preserves prior breach. Baseline fixture replay retains the authored 1927 breach and 1928 cure without labeling the breach lawful.

review_examples.name: Foreign gold purchase
review_examples.setup: A foreign concession sells delivered gold to the Reserve Bank.
review_examples.expected: Credit/payment and reserve ownership reconcile. Foreign GDP remains foreign and Treasury revenue is not created automatically.

review_examples.name: Adverse fiscal path
review_examples.setup: A revenue shock causes debt-service or cash-buffer failure.
review_examples.expected: The path remains in the denominator with costs and recovery/terminal effects; it is not dropped as an invalid strategy.

review_examples.name: Unsupported outcome
review_examples.setup: A candidate lacks a usable human-cost or household-consumption mechanism.
review_examples.expected: The corresponding metric is unavailable or a named proxy is explicitly selected. Unknown values cannot be zero or a winning score.

review_examples.name: Gulf admission shortcut
review_examples.setup: A policy offers admission before all continuing tests and consent are satisfied.
review_examples.expected: Admission is unavailable; an oil, trade or defence agreement remains a separate action with its own consent and costs.

review_examples.name: Hidden feasibility
review_examples.setup: Identical actor observations, different concealed counterparty liquidity.
review_examples.expected: Menus, previews and attempts match before allowed disclosure; actual adjudication and later observations may differ.

review_examples.name: Succession and false report
review_examples.setup: An officeholder changes while an obligation survives and an actor receives a false report.
review_examples.expected: Institutional obligations persist through explicit succession; the delivered report updates only beliefs under the registered rule, not underlying truth.

review_examples.name: Competing commitments
review_examples.setup: Two contemporaneous attempts claim the same funds or transport.
review_examples.expected: Registered reservations/allocation and atomic-or-partial settlement conserve resources and do not depend on incidental actor ordering.

review_examples.name: Decision branch
review_examples.setup: A checkpoint includes a pending promise, delayed report and hidden belief.
review_examples.expected: Unchanged resumption matches; a selected decision/premise/imposed-event branch preserves its prefix, complete state and conditionality.

review_examples.name: Dominated but useful story
review_examples.setup: A narrative-interesting policy is strategically dominated.
review_examples.expected: Extract causal candidates before strategic pruning, surface a dominated story without a requested ending, permit a spontaneous bookmark and retain its assets.

review_examples.name: Applicability lost
review_examples.setup: A financing rule loses its assumed institutional conditions.
review_examples.expected: Withhold dependent claims; an explicitly selected registered provisional continuation creates a conditional linked branch and remains counted.

review_examples.name: Author usefulness
review_examples.setup: The bounded dilemma is used on predeclared Pacifica writing tasks.
review_examples.expected: Prepared and open-ended writing tasks, a supported question withheld from tuning, and notes/manual-workflow comparison; inspect new causal ideas and their assumptions, agency, branch clarity, time and repair before author acceptance.

review_examples.name: Delayed reports
review_examples.setup: Reports about March cash arrive out of order in June; current truth, target period, historical beliefs and immutable delivered payloads remain distinct. Overlapping resolved state conflicts fail validation.
review_examples.expected: Satisfy the named semantic and acceptance contracts before the supported feature is enabled.

review_examples.name: Decision capacity and metric isolation
review_examples.setup: Substitute an officeholder while preserving institutional liabilities; decision authority, private beliefs and commitments follow explicit bindings. MetricSample data cannot enter the actor view without an Observation channel.
review_examples.expected: Satisfy the named semantic and acceptance contracts before the supported feature is enabled.
