review_examples.expected: Satisfy the named semantic and acceptance contracts before the supported feature is enabled.

review_examples.name: Population lineage
review_examples.setup: 100 root worlds with 20 unsupported parent paths and 20 provisional continuations retain 100 parent evaluations and 120 branch executions; separate conditional results, retries and cache reuse without inventing independent evidence.
review_examples.expected: Satisfy the named semantic and acceptance contracts before the supported feature is enabled.

review_examples.name: Dramatic structure
review_examples.setup: Two histories with similar financial outcomes but different frustrated plans remain distinct story candidates; numerical jitter of one conflict does not create another. Derived dramatic claims cite decisions and effects and never mutate the world.
review_examples.expected: Satisfy the named semantic and acceptance contracts before the supported feature is enabled.

review_examples.name: Additive conduct permissions
review_examples.setup: Compare valid and concealed invalid authority under additive conduct permissions with matched actor inputs: the attempt stays the same, legality/execution/disclosure differ appropriately, and a breach-capable counterparty can honour its agreement.
review_examples.expected: Satisfy the named bounded semantic and acceptance contracts before enabling the feature.

review_examples.name: Claim admissibility
review_examples.setup: Force a refusal: retain conditional consequences but do not claim controller generation. A separate plausibility assessment can qualify an isolated action intervention for consequence evidence; unsupported motives cannot. Regenerated policy/premise variants keep distinct claim scopes.
review_examples.expected: Satisfy the named bounded semantic and acceptance contracts before enabling the feature.

review_examples.name: Resolved experiment identity
review_examples.setup: Change cash premises, conduct bindings or fidelity while keeping policy/model versions fixed: experiment and evaluation keys change; display labels do not. Preserve valid matched root IDs and separate branch/retry accounting.
review_examples.expected: Satisfy the named bounded semantic and acceptance contracts before enabling the feature.

review_examples.name: Independent open proposals
review_examples.setup: From an enumerable allowed proposal family, open exploration generates and surfaces a distinctive dominated route missed by its declared strategic comparator under fixed budgets; no target ending or pre-inserted path is supplied.
review_examples.expected: Satisfy the named bounded semantic and acceptance contracts before enabling the feature.

review_examples.name: Consequential agency contrast
review_examples.setup: Compare two independently plausible actions at one checkpoint with unchanged continuation rules and matched other inputs; trace the changed consequence and next dilemma, plus a low-effect contrast. Test intention-sensitive controller generation separately.
review_examples.expected: Satisfy the named bounded semantic and acceptance contracts before enabling the feature.

review_examples.name: Isolated agency evidence
review_examples.setup: Hold continuation policy and all other mechanisms fixed while changing one plausible action; a separate policy-rule change must be labelled a policy comparison. Generation evidence and conditional consequence evidence cannot substitute for each other.
review_examples.expected: Satisfy the scoped acceptance contracts before enabling the feature.

review_examples.name: Content activation
review_examples.setup: Activate a 1927 snapshot: the authored 1928 settlement is reference-only, an existing debt schedule remains due, and no actor knows later events by import. Re-import is idempotent; source correction creates a new bundle and dependency-impact report.
review_examples.expected: Satisfy the scoped acceptance contracts before enabling the feature.

review_examples.name: Protected ambiguity
review_examples.setup: Preserve a locked unresolved culpability while characters react to supported testimony and suspicion. Import, sampling, queries and explanations cannot choose a secret culprit; a truth-dependent mechanism is withheld without suppressing valid unrelated behavior.
review_examples.expected: Satisfy the scoped acceptance contracts before enabling the feature.

review_examples.name: Relational consequences
review_examples.setup: A scoped private commitment, selective disclosure and belief update change a costly decision, cooperation and the next dilemma; two candidates remain causally distinct despite similar financial outcomes.
review_examples.expected: Satisfy the scoped acceptance contracts before enabling the feature.

review_examples.name: Resource budgets
review_examples.setup: Run and query under low RAM/disk budgets, adapt concurrency or stop cleanly, then recover. Preserve all outcomes/status counts and pinned replay/bookmark assets; measure process-tree peak memory and retained/temporary bytes.
review_examples.expected: Satisfy the scoped acceptance contracts before enabling the feature.

review_examples.name: Replay of unknown state
review_examples.setup: Initialize, hash, save and replay a protected unknown without choosing a culprit; belief-driven behavior runs, truth-dependent claims remain unavailable, and missing required configuration fails distinctly.
review_examples.expected: Satisfy the named bounded semantic and acceptance contracts before enabling the feature.

review_examples.name: Typed evidence states
review_examples.setup: Persist and resolve all five evidence-assessment statuses; retain an unassessed candidate with justified empty elements, reject fabricated supports, and require supported payloads for each mandatory agency case.
review_examples.expected: Satisfy the named bounded semantic and acceptance contracts before enabling the feature.

review_examples.name: Source omission audit
review_examples.setup: Remove a consequential source promise or veto and its references so dependency checks pass; an independent source-first sample audit detects the omission and blocks affected activation until repair or explicit rescoping.
review_examples.expected: Satisfy the named bounded semantic and acceptance contracts before enabling the feature.

review_examples.name: Relational counterexamples
review_examples.setup: Test concealed betrayal without unearned knowledge, a legally permissible breach of a nonbinding promise, and a truthful disclosure followed by disbelief or noncooperation under registered rules.
review_examples.expected: Satisfy the named bounded semantic and acceptance contracts before enabling the feature.

review_examples.name: Retain and develop an idea
review_examples.setup: Under a predeclared prepared/open/held-out and manual-comparator protocol, the author retains a previously unconsidered usable idea after assumption disclosure, branches to a subsequent supported dilemma, saves/replays it, and judges time, repair and usefulness.
review_examples.expected: Satisfy the named bounded semantic and acceptance contracts before enabling the feature.

ontology_contract.scope: Only records and mechanisms active in the bounded experiment must have runtime schemas/bindings; unsupported effects are disabled. The full catalog is not a prerequisite for R0.

common_required.scope: catalog, branch or run identity with explicit parent references
common_required.provenance_refs: source, assumption, author decision or generated-by references
common_required.revision_id: immutable revision ID; references pin this revision
common_required.recorded_at: author/engine record time, independent of fictional valid time
common_required.supersedes_ref: previous revision or explicit null; no destructive replacement

record_types.name: Entity
record_types.meaning: Person, office, institution, faction, community or other distinct bearer of identity.
record_types.invariant: Existing character IDs are reused or crosswalked; shared names do not establish identity.

record_types.name: RoleTenure
record_types.meaning: A dated relation between a person or collective and an office/institution.
record_types.invariant: Office powers, institutional assets and personal property remain separately owned.

record_types.name: Proposition
record_types.meaning: A grounded typed question about explicitly bound entities and a target time or interval.
record_types.invariant: Argument roles and target time are part of proposition identity; a claim about March cash is not a claim about June cash.

record_types.name: WorldFact
record_types.meaning: A branch-scoped underlying state assertion used by adjudication.
record_types.invariant: One resolved value per state key and effective instant; explicit split/supersession preserves older revisions. Unresolved truth is not a fabricated value.

record_types.name: Assertion
record_types.meaning: A source claim or public/private statement that may be false.
record_types.invariant: An assertion does not overwrite WorldFact or Belief; contradictory assertions retain their provenance.

record_types.name: Observation
record_types.meaning: Information actually delivered to a recipient.
record_types.invariant: The actor receives an immutable filtered payload. Later state edits or hidden provenance dereferences cannot alter or enlarge what was delivered.

record_types.name: Belief
record_types.meaning: An actor's representation of a proposition.
record_types.invariant: Proposition target time differs from the interval during which the actor holds the belief; delayed reports follow the registered update rule, not last-arrival wins.

record_types.name: Goal
record_types.meaning: An actor objective or selected personal intention.
record_types.invariant: Author narrative conditions are not actor goals unless explicitly and plausibly instantiated as such.

record_types.name: Plan
record_types.meaning: A persistent course of intended action.
record_types.invariant: Status records the owner's plan assessment; actual goal satisfaction is separately evaluated. Frustration by another actor differs from voluntary abandonment, and unrealized intended actions are not events.

record_types.name: Commitment
record_types.meaning: A promise or political undertaking distinct from legal liability.
record_types.invariant: Only a declared formation rule creates an Obligation; a promise is not automatic authority or consent.

record_types.name: Agreement
record_types.meaning: A qualified multiparty instrument governing rights and obligations.
record_types.invariant: Parties may include owners, sovereigns, local rights holders and beneficiaries; signatures and practical access are separate.

record_types.name: Obligation
record_types.meaning: A duty or claim with explicit bearer and beneficiary.
record_types.invariant: Succession, default, waiver and remedy change obligations only through explicit rules; creditor write-down alone is not discharge.

record_types.name: ActionAttempt
record_types.meaning: A chosen attempt based on actor-visible state.
record_types.invariant: The initiator is the decision-maker in the linked context; represented institutions, resource owners and authority remain separately identified.

record_types.name: Adjudication
record_types.meaning: The registered resolution of one or more attempts.
record_types.invariant: Actual legality, perceived authority, execution and disclosure are independent; errors in authority create no invented consent.

record_types.name: RealizedEvent
record_types.meaning: An actual modeled transition or explicitly imposed conditional event.
record_types.invariant: Generated, source-replay and author-imposed origins remain distinct; proposals and plans are not events.

record_types.name: Reservation
record_types.meaning: A claim on scarce resources pending settlement.
record_types.invariant: Held, consumed, released and expired reservations reconcile; failed negotiation releases only the resources specified by rule.

record_types.name: MechanismContract
record_types.meaning: Versioned dynamics and their domain of applicability.
record_types.invariant: Competing writers require a registered resolver; tests include independent reference/intervention cases and a counterexample.

record_types.name: ExplanationLink
record_types.meaning: A typed, scoped explanation relation.
record_types.invariant: Typed relations include prerequisite, resource_dependency, modeled_effect, observation_update, goal_threat, plan_frustration, opportunity, decision_sacrifice, association and author_interpretation. Derived dramatic relations require explicit supports and never create world effects.

record_types.name: DecisionCheckpoint
record_types.meaning: A complete state from which a decision can be resumed.
record_types.invariant: A checkpoint or deterministic reconstruction must retain latent state, plans, delayed information, reservations and obligations.

record_types.name: Intervention
record_types.meaning: A declared change with counterfactual lineage.
record_types.invariant: Modes: decision, premise, imposed_event. Ordinary policy search changes only authorized control-mask fields, not other actors' outcomes.

record_types.name: NarrativeQuery
record_types.meaning: An author request over histories, separate from policy utility.
record_types.invariant: Modes and target quantification are explicit. Open exploration allows no target predicate; any change-cost ranking requires a declared cost contract. No-match is not impossibility.

record_types.name: StoryBookmark
record_types.meaning: An author-retained policy or history independent of search pruning.
record_types.invariant: Query/candidate references may be explicitly null for spontaneous bookmarks. Assets remain reachable independently of pruning and the original selection query.

record_types.name: AuthorReview
record_types.meaning: Evidence that the tool supports declared writing tasks.
record_types.invariant: Includes open exploration and a writing question withheld from tuning; author judgment, discovery contribution and technical validity remain separate.

record_types.name: PredicateDefinition
record_types.meaning: A versioned signature and state/query meaning for a supported predicate.
record_types.invariant: Only registered active predicates execute. A materialized fact and numeric runtime state cannot become competing independent writers.

record_types.name: DecisionContext
record_types.meaning: The authority, information and decision procedure in force for a choice.
record_types.invariant: A role supplies only its dated authority. Private goals influence a choice only through the pinned procedure; changing officeholders does not transfer private beliefs or institutional assets automatically.

record_types.name: DecisionRecord
record_types.meaning: An immutable record of a choice and the procedure that produced it.
record_types.invariant: Reasons come from the executed decision procedure. Author overrides are labeled and cannot acquire retrospective actor motives.

record_types.name: StoryCandidate
record_types.meaning: A derived, supported dramatic reading of an actual history, independent of strategic rank.
record_types.invariant: A candidate creates no world facts or intentions. Unknown dramatic elements remain explicit; causal diversity is not a score for literary quality.

record_types.name: MetricSample
record_types.meaning: A numerical or qualitative measured result for author analysis, distinct from delivered actor information.
record_types.invariant: Metric samples enter actor information only through an explicit observation channel and filtered immutable payload.

record_types.name: EvaluationPopulation
record_types.meaning: The membership, selection and weighting contract for reported results.
record_types.invariant: Worlds, policy-world evaluations, attempts/retries and descendant branch executions are separate counting units; descendants do not inflate their parent population.

invariants.name: Identity and succession
invariants.rule: Name equality never merges entities. Dated role changes preserve institution/person ownership and require explicit transfer or succession rules.

invariants.name: Qualified relationships
invariants.rule: Rights, consent and obligations name participants, subject, authority, conditions and dates. Practical control and legal title remain independent.

invariants.name: Truth and information
invariants.rule: Assertions, world truth, delivered observations and beliefs are separate. Unknown, absent, false/refused, disputed and unmodeled differ. Tagged unknown state with a valid resolution policy is serializable and replayable; missing required configuration is an error. Protected ambiguity is never silently sampled or branched into a hidden answer.

invariants.name: Time and branch
invariants.rule: Use explicit branch/run scope; valid/effective time, information receipt and author record/save time are distinct. Preserve an established prefix unless a declared earlier fork changes it.

invariants.name: Intentionality
invariants.rule: Goals and plans belong to named actors and have supported update reasons. Unrealized intentions do not count as events or outcomes.

invariants.name: Observation isolation
invariants.rule: Policy inputs, eligibility masks, previews, validation messages and response search knowledge obey the same observation boundary; hidden policy code is not public by default.

invariants.name: Adjudication and conservation
invariants.rule: Attempts, resolutions and effects are distinct. Reservations and settlement conserve owned resources and follow registered phases independent of incidental iteration order.

invariants.name: Legality profiles
invariants.rule: Conduct profiles bind named actors/action families to explicit additive permitted-category sets. Lawful conduct remains available in every profile; actual legality is independently adjudicated and permission never compels misconduct. Exceptional execution requires variant-specific support and never relaxes physical invariants, independent consent or locked premises.

invariants.name: Applicability and status propagation
invariants.rule: Runtime validity failures and selected provisional assumptions propagate to affected claims. Conditional/error paths remain counted and cannot silently enter stronger rankings.

invariants.name: Explanation scope
invariants.rule: A causal claim needs a registered mechanism or declared intervention analysis; associations, prerequisites and author interpretations remain separately typed.

invariants.name: Narrative and strategic selection
invariants.rule: Open exploration has an explicit proposal method and budget independent of strategic fitness; candidate selection then precedes strategic pruning. Actor information and independent choices remain binding. Author conditions/bookmarks do not alter utilities, and targeted-history frequencies retain their population.

invariants.name: Replay and retention
invariants.rule: Decision-state reconstruction preserves latent actor/world state, queues, obligations and draw identities. Saved bookmarks and results keep referenced assets reachable.

invariants.name: Predicate state and revisions
invariants.rule: Argument roles, target time, state keys and authoritative writers are registered. Immutable revisions and delivered snapshots preserve past facts and beliefs; out-of-order reports cannot silently rewrite them.

invariants.name: Decision ownership and reasons
invariants.rule: Every attempt binds decision-maker, principal, authority, resources and actual decision procedure. Plausibility assessment, controller selection and isolated consequence evidence remain separate. Overrides retain their origin and cannot certify actor-generated discovery or reliability, but independently plausible interventions can supply conditional consequence evidence.

invariants.name: Search and temporal interpretation
invariants.rule: Queries declare actor-generated or mechanical-consequence claims separately from search mode. Only admissible actor-generated histories can certify found_supported under their declared premises. Incomplete or unsupported histories cannot satisfy unresolved temporal conditions; budget exhaustion is not impossibility.

invariants.name: Population accounting
invariants.rule: Every evaluation references the same canonical resolved experiment used for calculation identity; root-world identity remains separate for valid matched comparisons. Every summary declares membership, counting unit, conditioning and weights. Retries and conditional descendants cannot inflate independent worlds or replace unsupported parent outcomes.

ontology_contract.unsupported_policy: Stop or withhold affected claims by default; an explicitly selected registered provisional continuation creates a new conditional branch without fabricating missing state.

conduct_contract.binding: Explicit actor ID or declared actor set plus action family, effective interval and rule version. Resolve overlaps by declared precedence; missing bindings fail configuration. Profile categories are an upper bound: each exceptional action variant also needs explicit enabling and consequence coverage.
conduct_contract.lawful: Permits lawful_execution. Actor attempts and visible menus obey actor information; adjudication rejects actual unlawful execution without leaking concealed reasons before permitted disclosure.
conduct_contract.apparent_authority: Adds mistaken_authority_execution to lawful execution: a registered physically possible but actually unauthorized act may execute when the actor believes it authorized under the pinned credibility rule. Actual legality is independently adjudicated; valid authority produces an ordinary lawful outcome.
conduct_contract.breach_exploration: Adds intentional_breach_execution to the apparent_authority set. Only explicitly enabled exceptional variants with supported consequences may execute. The actor may still act lawfully, honour an agreement or decline to act; permission never compels misconduct.
conduct_contract.classification: Adjudication resolves actual legality independently of the profile name. An actually authorized act uses lawful_execution even if the actor misunderstood its status; intention/perceived authority are separate recorded dimensions. An actually unauthorized act requires the applicable mistaken-authority or intentional-breach category and its registered rule. Unknown/disputed material truth follows its resolution policy; only permitted hypotheses may resolve it, otherwise the dependent adjudication is unsupported. A nonbinding personal promise violation is classified by its actual legal status, not the word breach; legally permissible conduct or conduct with no applicable legal restriction may use lawful_execution while social consequences remain separately modeled.
conduct_contract.mixed_world: Pacifica can be lawful while a counterparty has broader permissions. Independent procedures choose actions; no profile creates consent, title, resources or favourable outcomes.

quantification.filter: Evaluate a declared predicate over an existing population; no new search.
quantification.open_exploration: Surface causally varied generated histories without a required ending or strategic objective set.
quantification.existential_history: Find at least one supported generated history satisfying the target under declared policy/sampling bounds; no frequency promise.
quantification.policy_reliability: Compare frozen policies by target satisfaction over a declared fresh unconditioned population; report probabilities only where the world model supports them.
quantification.minimum_premise_change: Find best-found allowed premise edits and a witness history, with explicit costs/lexicographic order; assess each premise package separately.

query_contract.sampling: A story sampler may target or stratify declared uncertain conditions; it records its selection method and proposal/weight contract. It cannot select favorable seeds as policy variables, force counterpart acceptance or turn targeted shares into ordinary probabilities.
query_contract.interventions: Search and intervention modes are separate. Decision changes obey the control mask; an admissible policy change must actually produce the decision through the pinned procedure. One-off author overrides and imposed events remain conditional consequences. Premise changes create separately identified experiments and cannot certify the original premises.
query_contract.decision_change_cost: existential_history may rank permitted decision/policy edits by an explicit change-cost contract; units/order, bounds and ties are required, and global minimality is claimed only for the exhaustively checked bounded space.

claim_admissibility.actor_generated: Every choice in the assessed history, including its inherited prefix, must be produced by its pinned actor/controller procedure under declared premises and control mask. Author overrides, imposed events and provisional continuations cannot certify found_supported or ordinary policy reliability; their separate consequence evidence remains available.
claim_admissibility.mechanical_consequence: An explicitly allowed override or imposed event can explore supported downstream mechanics. A matching such history returns found_conditional with its origins, assumptions and mechanics coverage, even if all downstream calculations are supported; it does not demonstrate the actor would choose the intervention.
claim_admissibility.changed_premises: A permitted changed character, policy or world premise must be versioned in a new resolved experiment and regenerated from before its effect. If procedures then produce the choices without overrides, the witness can be found_supported under those premises only; changed premise differences remain visible and never become baseline evidence.
claim_admissibility.propagation: Claim basis and disqualifying origins travel with inherited lineage, queries, candidates, bookmarks and exports. Replaying a forced decision through independent generation creates new evidence; it never relabels the original override. Unsupported mechanics remain unsupported and incomplete predicates unresolved.
claim_admissibility.default_discovery: Default actor-generated discovery excludes override/imposed/provisional histories. Explicit conditional exploration can retain them; an independently plausible isolated decision intervention can support the consequence component of author agency review, never controller-generation evidence.
claim_admissibility.assessment_boundary: Declare the assessment start and initialized source premises. Pre-start source facts are premises, not claims that earlier choices were simulated. All generated decisions and inherited intervention lineage within the assessed interval remain in scope; moving a report window cannot hide an earlier intervention that affects the claimed result.

population_contract.branch_key: Unique run/branch identity with resolved_experiment_id, branch_spec_id, parent evaluation/checkpoint/prefix, and intervention/provisional lineage; descendants never overwrite the parent evaluation.
population_contract.example: 100 root worlds with 20 unsupported paths and 20 provisional child continuations remain 100 original policy-world evaluations: 80 supported and 20 unsupported. There are 120 logical branch executions before retries. The 20 continuations form a selected conditional population, not 20 added independent worlds.
population_contract.aggregation: Preserve root status; report a continuation scenario separately. If justified outcome bounds exist, publish lower/upper aggregate bounds over the original population; otherwise withhold the affected aggregate. Retries, cache hits and reused evaluations are cost/accounting fields, not new evidence.

NarrativeQuery: change_cost_contract when no change-cost ranking is requested
nullability_contract.rule: Explicit null and empty supported-reference sets are meaningful only where the type permits them; unknown evidence must remain marked unknown, never silently inferred.
ChoiceEvidenceAssessment: assessment_method_ref, assessor_ref and dimension_payload only for not_assessed or not_applicable with reason
support_refs may be empty for non-supported status with reason
assumption_refs may be empty when no assumptions apply
StoryCandidate: Missing dramatic element reference arrays may be empty only with corresponding element_statuses and reason
choice_evidence_refs always pins three dimensional assessments, including explicit not_assessed or not_applicable when appropriate

resolved_experiment_contract.form: Content fingerprint of a canonical resolved manifest; a manifest contract within existing experiment/run scope, not an additional world entity.
includes: resolved scenario state and dated premise interventions
declared decision, premise and imposed-event interventions with effective and information times
policy/controller, actor-model and mechanism versions and parameters
conduct bindings, permitted-category sets and enabled variants
fidelity, projection, schema, binding and identity-contract versions
horizon, clocks, constraints and active predicates
world design, uncertainty distributions and indexed draw allocation
supported engine environment and dependency builds
activated content manifest semantics, initialization and ambiguity bindings
excludes: search ranking or narrative selection that does not alter generated history
resolved_experiment_contract.canonicalization: Resolve defaults, units, time zones and references to immutable semantic content; sort unordered maps/sets and preserve semantically ordered sequences. Pin number/time serialization and canonicalization version, and reject missing required configuration while canonically preserving declared unknown/disputed value states and their resolution policies. Display-name changes preserve identity; changes to any included semantic value change it. Keep provenance and presentation metadata separately retained.
resolved_experiment_contract.calculation: calculation_key = (resolved_experiment_id, root_world_id, assessment_stage, branch_spec_id). branch_spec_id fingerprints the parent checkpoint/prefix and normalized intervention or root marker; runtime branch/run IDs additionally preserve lineage.
resolved_experiment_contract.evaluation: evaluation_key = (resolved_experiment_id, root_world_id, assessment_stage). The original evaluation remains distinct from descendant branch executions; a changed semantic continuation references its new resolved experiment as well as its parent evaluation.
resolved_experiment_contract.matching: root_world_id identifies external conditions within a compatible pinned world design. It is separate from experiment identity so matched comparisons remain possible across policy, premise, conduct or fidelity variants only where draw meanings remain valid. The same root ID alone proves neither equivalence nor causality.
resolved_experiment_contract.retries: Retries and cache hits retain the same calculation/evaluation identity and never add statistical evidence. Cache reuse requires an exact calculation key; matching only a root world or policy version is insufficient.

required: proposal and rollout budgets with stopping rules
attempted, rejected, evaluated and retained counts
exploration_proposal_contract.r0: Enumerate a small declared family of actor-admissible Pacifica policy settings or procedural choice alternatives independently of strategic fitness. Execute the actual controller with existing information, goals and commitments; counterparties choose independently. If an option needs a forced decision or changed character premise, classify it accordingly.
exploration_proposal_contract.later: A separately budgeted open-exploration stream may use bounded policy variation or underrepresented causal structures, but must admit proposals without requiring strategic improvement or descent from elite policies. Structural or character changes remain explicit premise packages.
exploration_proposal_contract.routing: Send every evaluated trace to the candidate selector before strategic pruning. Keep proposal coverage distinct from selector coverage, retention and omitted possibilities; share cached computation without merging populations or double-counting evidence.
exploration_proposal_contract.acceptance: Start from the allowed proposal family, not a pre-populated history set. Under fixed stated budgets, generate and surface a causally distinct dominated route omitted by the declared purely strategic proposal/pruning comparator. Log the proposal and executed decision provenance. Do not name its ending in the query or use a golden output as generator input.

dimensions.plausibility: A versioned assessment of an alternative against the actor-visible decision state, commitments, capabilities and permitted conduct; supported, unsupported or unresolved, with reasons and source/assumption refs. This assessment is distinct from the executed choice procedure.
dimensions.generation: DecisionRecord.selection_origin and procedure trace state whether the controller selected the action or the author intervened. Plausibility alone does not imply selection or probability.
dimensions.consequence: A controlled comparison changes one selected attempt at a complete checkpoint while keeping all other mechanisms and continuation policy settings fixed; descendants may differ through recomputed state and observations.

comparison_contract: unchanged continuation policy and mechanism fingerprints
matched external draw mapping and other random inputs except the intervened choice draw
first divergence and consequence/next-dilemma support refs
agency_evidence_contract.r0: Demonstrate controller-generated intention-sensitive behavior separately, then compare two supported plausible actions at one decision under an isolated intervention. An author-selected alternative may contribute conditional consequence evidence when its plausibility is independently supported. Include a separate low-effect contrast.
agency_evidence_contract.limits: An override never proves that the actor would choose it or enters actor-generated reliability. Missing plausibility evidence blocks the agency gate. A changed continuing policy or character/world premise is a separately labelled policy/premise comparison, not an isolated action effect. Subsequent choices respond normally to changed endogenous states under unchanged rules.

ambiguity_contract.binding: Each Proposition pins an immutable resolution_policy_ref within its experiment context; PredicateDefinition.resolution_rule_ref supplies an explicit default. Validation resolves overrides and authorial locks before initialization.

policies.resolve_from_evidence: Resolved adjudicator truth may be concealed from actors by observation rules; no truth is invented where evidence or an explicit permitted assumption is missing.
policies.author_decision_required: The author has not decided. Keep unresolved; a separately declared permitted hypothesis is an assumption, never canon.
policies.preserve_ambiguity: The author requires nonresolution. No importer, random sampler, adjudicator, optimizer, explanation or narration chooses a hidden answer or infers one from a candidate ending.
policies.outside_coverage: The model does not cover this question. Mark dependent claims unsupported; do not use zero, false or a fabricated answer.

ambiguity_contract.execution: Mechanisms may use supported assertions, suspicions and observations without resolving protected truth. If a mechanism requires the answer, withhold that affected computation or use an explicitly supported formulation independent of it; unaffected mechanisms continue. Do not discard the whole history automatically.
ambiguity_contract.change_control: A preserve_ambiguity lock can change only through an explicit authorial premise revision, never a search variable or automatic hypothesis branch. Responsibility for Noe's death remains protected and unresolved.

content_manifest_contract.kind: ExperimentContentManifest within the existing versioned experiment bundle; not an additional world record or database service.

content_roles.initial_fact: Settled before the declared start; initialize under its authority/evidence status.
content_roles.active_obligation: Existing duty or commitment whose schedule/conditions continue into the horizon; future due dates are not guaranteed payment outcomes.
content_roles.reference_outcome: Authored future event retained for comparison only; never enqueued as a generated result or exposed as actor foresight.
content_roles.external_scenario_assumption: Explicit external event/distribution with applicability, timing and channel rules; not a device to force an endogenous response.
content_roles.narrative_constraint: Explicit author condition evaluated as a filter/search constraint; cannot write world state or force compliance.

content_manifest_contract.activation_gate: Every transitive dependency of an active mechanism, information initializer and requested claim has a disposition: sourced, explicit assumption, excluded with affected claims disabled, or blocking unresolved. No missing reference is silently invented. Referential completeness alone does not establish mechanism coverage. SourceCoverageLedger and its independent sample review must also pass; a closed dependency graph cannot establish that no source claim was omitted.
content_manifest_contract.identity: All executable content roles, state and bindings enter resolved_experiment_id. Extraction provenance, source spans and manifest revisions remain retained; reference-only annotations do not change calculation identity unless their semantic use changes.
content_manifest_contract.incrementality: Stage extraction proposals separately from active bundles. Stable IDs and source-span links survive re-import; no duplicates, automatic canon promotion or edits to source files. Source revisions produce impact reports and new bundles while old runs remain reproducible. Reconcile source coverage units, sample expectations and the author-decision queue on every affected source revision.

first_slice: disclose or withhold a known report through a named channel
honour or breach a promise with a supported relationship consequence
relational_action_contract.acceptance: A private commitment and selective disclosure change a supported belief, then a costly choice, cooperation and a subsequent dilemma. Produce two causally distinct candidates with similar financial outcomes; explanation links alone do not count as state changes.
relational_action_contract.limits: Use a few reviewed qualitative relationship states and transitions. No universal trust score or complete psychology is required. Silence changes beliefs only through an explicit expectation/observation rule; it cannot reveal hidden reports.
failure_cases: A concealed promise breach alone cannot alter another actor's beliefs or choices. Deliver supported evidence, inference cues or observations before the registered response rule can change them; world effects can still occur independently.

Breaking a nonbinding personal promise can be lawful execution or legally not applicable while producing supported social consequences. Record promise fulfillment separately from actual legal status; do not require intentional_breach_execution solely because the narrative calls it betrayal.

A truthful disclosure need not be believed or produce trust/cooperation. Test a registered case in which credibility, conflicting goals or costs lead to disbelief, refusal or reduced cooperation without changing the reported truth.

value_state_contract.representation: WorldFact.value and equivalent runtime fields use a tagged value state under the predicate definition: known(value), unknown(reason_ref), disputed(assertion_refs), unmodeled(reason_ref), not_applicable(reason_ref), or explicitly_absent(evidence_refs). Known false is a value, never a missingness marker. Observation and Belief payloads retain their own distinct actor scope.
value_state_contract.binding: A proposition always has a valid predicate signature, value domain, scope and resolution policy. The policy and tag are explicit immutable semantics, independent of whether the underlying truth is known. No bare null, NaN, zero or empty collection substitutes for a declared unknown.
value_state_contract.initialization: Validate types, references and policy first. A well-formed unknown or disputed value can initialize, hash, save and replay. Reject missing required schemas, policy references, units, ownership or active runtime bindings, rather than rejecting the package merely because truth is unknown.
value_state_contract.execution: An active mechanism declares which tagged states it accepts. If it requires unavailable truth, withhold that computation and propagate unsupported status only to dependent claims. Rules using supported testimony, suspicion or beliefs may continue without reading the unresolved truth.
value_state_contract.hypothesis: Hypothesis branching is permitted only by the pinned resolution policy and explicit scenario scope. preserve_ambiguity forbids automatic branching, sampling or completion; changing that lock requires an explicit authorial premise revision.
value_state_contract.canonicalization: Hash the tag, reason/assertion/evidence references resolved to immutable semantic content, resolution policy and applicable predicate bindings. An unchanged unknown package has stable identity; permitted changes of tag, policy or truth change semantic identity. Missing required configuration fails resolution.
value_state_contract.regression: Initialize, hash, save and replay protected unresolved responsibility for Noe's death. Belief-driven behavior continues without identifying a culprit; a truth-dependent query or mechanism remains unavailable, and a missing required binding fails before execution.

evidence_assessment_contract.storage: Versioned supporting artifact using the common identity, revision, scope and provenance fields; no additional world record type.

statuses.supported: The stated dimensional claim is established within its declared scope and assumptions.
statuses.unsupported: Required support or mechanism coverage is absent, or evidence establishes that the stated claim does not hold; record the specific reason.
statuses.unresolved: The assessment was attempted but a named uncertainty or open question prevents a conclusion.
statuses.not_assessed: No assessment has been completed for this dimension; this is not evidence of failure or success.
statuses.not_applicable: The dimension does not apply to the declared subject; justify this explicitly, never use it to waive a required release case.

evidence_assessment_contract.reference_targets: StoryCandidate.choice_evidence_refs pins one current assessment per dimension for its declared focal decision/comparison or history scope. AuthorReview.agency_evidence_refs pins the assessments used by each required trial case, not free-text labels. Subject refs are nonempty immutable references to the relevant history, context, action or comparison.
evidence_assessment_contract.nullability: assessment_method_ref, assessor_ref and dimension_payload may be explicit null only for not_assessed or not_applicable, with a reason. support_refs may be empty for a non-supported status with an explicit missingness/coverage reason; assumption_refs may be empty when none apply. supported requires nonempty support_refs and non-null method, assessor and dimension payload. Subject refs never disappear.

payloads.plausibility: context_ref, action_spec_ref, considered_goal_and_commitment_refs, capability_and_conduct_refs, rationale; evaluate the actor-visible state without inventing an executed motive.
payloads.generation: decision_record_ref and selection_origin copied from the recorded procedure. An author override is unsupported for the controller-generation claim, even if its conditional consequences are supported.
payloads.consequence: comparison_ref to the isolated-action comparison manifest under agency_evidence_contract.comparison_contract, including changed fields, fixed continuation rules, horizon/materiality and consequence supports.

evidence_assessment_contract.candidate_nullability: Existing focal_actor_refs, goal_refs, obstacle_or_conflict_refs, decision_refs, sacrifice_refs, consequence_refs and unresolved_tension_refs may be empty when evidence is missing. StoryCandidate adds element_statuses, with each field marked supported, unsupported, unresolved, not_assessed or not_applicable plus a reason for any empty set. A supported element needs at least one immutable support. Unsupported interpretations stay explicitly labelled; no invented sacrifice or motive fills a slot.
evidence_assessment_contract.gate: Draft candidates can be retained with unassessed or inapplicable dimensions. Required agency release cases need supported evidence in each applicable dimension across their declared separate tests. No unknown, unassessed, unsupported or inapplicable status counts as passing a required case; no aggregate score promotes an override into controller generation.

source_coverage_contract.storage: Versioned supporting artifact linked by ExperimentContentManifest; retained with the source bundle, not a new world entity.
source_coverage_contract.scope: Predeclare selected documents/sections and stable passage units from source text before consulting extraction output. Cover every unit in that scope; follow relevant cross-references or record a justified boundary. Do not define the scope as only passages that the extractor noticed.
source_coverage_contract.integrity: extracted requires record revision refs; excluded requires a reason such as irrelevance or supersession; unresolved requires a named question and affected-claim disposition. A mapped passage can still contain omitted claims, so ledger coverage alone is insufficient.
source_coverage_contract.audit: Build a small reference sample in a separate source-first review pass, without deriving its expected facts from the extraction output. Predeclare sampling and include identities, obligations/promises, veto/authority, knowledge restrictions and chronology. Compare expected claims with records and their authority/times, inspect exclusions, and record omissions, false additions, repairs and remaining limits. Report audited sample size; no unsupported whole-corpus recall claim.
source_coverage_contract.omission_test: Deliberately remove a consequential promise or veto and its direct references so ordinary referential/dependency validation still passes. The independent expected-claim comparison must detect the omission and block activation of affected scope until repaired or explicitly rescoped.
source_coverage_contract.activation: No unreviewed source unit or unresolved material sampled discrepancy may be silently accepted. A reviewed exclusion may disable dependent claims; source completeness review and executable dependency validation are separate gates.
source_coverage_contract.queue: Each unresolved author decision records question, source refs, affected records/claims, blocking status, responsible reviewer, decision status and waiting time. No elapsed-time or model-generated answer is author approval.

author_trial_contract.artifact_type: AuthorTrialProtocol and retained AuthorReview evidence in the existing experiment layer
predeclare: at least one supported-domain question withheld from model/output tuning
author acceptance procedure and required evidence
author_trial_contract.execution: Before tuning, record the actual tasks and numeric time/repair budgets. Run prepared/open/held-out work and the scoped manual comparator; record prior exposure and learning/order limitations. The author inspects assumptions, retains at least one previously unconsidered usable plot possibility, then branches from that retained idea into a subsequent supported dilemma. Save and replay the chain with unchanged identity.
required_evidence: author judgment that the idea was previously unconsidered and remains usable after assumption disclosure
time to retained idea and branch
explanation gaps and manual repair work
author_trial_contract.pass: Pass only with the retained-and-developed idea, inspectable assumptions, supported branch/replay, completed required tasks and explicit author acceptance under the predeclared time/repair limits. A failed budget or required case needs repair and reassessment or an explicit prospective scope/protocol revision; never retroactively widen limits to pass.
author_trial_contract.limits: A prepared chain, attractive prose, a populated sacrifice slot or an automatic quality score cannot substitute for author usefulness. If held-out feedback informs tuning, the task becomes development material and a fresh supported-domain question is required. Single-author comparisons report exposure and learning limits without claiming population-level improvement.

schema_change_note: Revision 0.10 defines typed unresolved state and evidence-assessment artifacts, source coverage and omission audits, relational counterexamples and the retain-and-branch author trial. It strengthens existing requirements without adding world record types. Required manifest references and payload contracts need migration if consumers exist; runtime schemas remain unimplemented.
